# Qefro

> Qefro is an AI Business Platform. Turn customer conversations into business outcomes.

Qefro connects AI with your business data, workflows, automations and apps — so customers get answers and work actually gets done.

Not primarily a chatbot, support bot, generic CRM, LLM wrapper, or automation tool.

## Outcome

Conversation → Data → Action → Outcome

AI can answer, find, act, follow up, and complete work. People stay in the loop for permissions, workflows, and approvals.

## How it starts

1. Create a workspace
2. Install Marketplace apps
3. Let Qefro run the work
4. Optionally connect WhatsApp, website, or mobile — same business, same data, same AI

## Trial

14-day free trial. Choose apps, connect your business, experience the outcome, then pick a paid plan.

Starter ₹699/month (1 user) · Pro ₹1,499/month (5 users) · Growth ₹2,999/month (15 users). Marketplace apps billed separately.
